label: The alleged recurrence making…: In the 1908 A-series argument, every further explanatory A series…
term: the alleged recurrence making McTaggart’s explanatory regress vicious
definition: In the 1908 A-series argument, every further explanatory A series is alleged to inherit the original incompatibility, so an explanation that merely relocates it leaves the original demand unanswered. This is a claim about recurrence of an unresolved contradiction, not a definition of all infinite chains as vicious. The asserted recurrence and the original incompatibility require defense.
